summary: The diff implements the core Mood Music UI (mood selection, local catalog metadata, latest sorting, and in-browser audio play/pause) and updates header branding. However, required static assets (mood icons and bundled audio files) are not shown as added, and the entry point is labeled “Music” rather than “Mood Music”.

missing_requirements.requirement: UI includes a clearly labeled entry point for "Mood Music" (e.g., a new tab alongside existing tabs).
missing_requirements.reason: A new tab/entry point exists, but the tab label shown in the diff is "Music", not "Mood Music".

missing_requirements.requirement: At least 8 sample tracks are available as static assets under the frontend public directory (e.g., frontend/public/assets/music).
missing_requirements.reason: The catalog references 8 mp3 URLs under /assets/music, but no corresponding audio files under frontend/public/assets/music are included in the added/modified files list.

missing_requirements.requirement: All required mood icon images are checked into frontend/public/assets/generated and used in the Mood Music UI.
missing_requirements.reason: The UI references the generated icon paths, but the actual image files are not shown as added in the diff (no files under frontend/public/assets/generated appear in the file list).

hallucinated_features.description: Sticky "Now Playing" mini-player with seek/progress slider and time formatting.
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-9 only requires standard in-browser play/pause controls; a persistent player UI with seeking is additional functionality not explicitly requested.
